subject.title: /stop abort leaves streaming card in idle state, blocking subsequent messages (replies=0)

question: After a live Feishu trace, should the durable fix live in shared reply-operation abort/admission cleanup, Feishu streaming-card settlement, or both?
rationale: The observable bug crosses shared `/stop` dispatch state and Feishu CardKit lifecycle, and choosing the wrong boundary could either preserve message loss or weaken intentional abort suppression.

options.title: Trace first, then fix both implicated boundaries if needed
options.body: Use a Feishu-capable run to prove whether the stale state is shared, plugin-local, or both before scoping a repair.

options.title: Patch Feishu streaming cleanup only
options.body: This may clear the visible stuck card but could leave the shared active-abort zero-reply admission behavior untouched.

options.title: Patch shared abort admission only
options.body: This may restore next-turn invocation but could miss CardKit cleanup if the Feishu stream is already stuck in an idle state.

recommendation.title: Trace first, then fix both implicated boundaries if needed
recommendation.body: Use a Feishu-capable run to prove whether the stale state is shared, plugin-local, or both before scoping a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared dispatch history makes this the best initial owner for deciding whether the active-abort admission path needs to change before Feishu-specific cleanup.
